notes: An RFC body page. Lines 0-2 are the running head and 49-51 the running foot. The indented monospace ABNF blocks (6, 7, 11, 12, 15-19, 23, 24, 26, 27, 30, 42) are grammar listings: DocLayNet has no code class and they are not mathematics, so they stay Text. They are the interesting negative case -- they sit at a different size and indent from the prose around them, which is exactly the signal a size-based heuristic keys on.
